dedupe_keys.name: policy responses to ai driven data center expansion under energy and water constraints an event based dataset

description: This deposit reports 67 policy events concerning data-centre expansion under electricity and water constraints. Zenodo provides one public archive under CC BY 4.0. The provider description names restrictions, moratoria, infrastructure reinforcement and capacity-expansion measures responding to grid congestion, water scarcity or environmental limits. Event histories of this kind can set institutional constraints and policy timing in data-centre siting or cross-sector expansion simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this event register. A limitation is that the public page does not enumerate jurisdictions, dates, coding columns, event selection rules or whether each measure was proposed or implemented. Summary figures and tables are included with the event data, but the internal archive structure was not inspected. The register should therefore support exploratory scenario design, not a complete count of worldwide policy responses or a calibrated causal effect. No archive was downloaded, and no event or legal status was independently checked.
